title: Article 300A — Property as a constitutional legal right

content.overview: Article 300A is the current property clause. Deprivation requires authority of law. It is not a Part III fundamental right.
content.study: Do not plead repealed Article 31 as current law. 300A is a legal right: the statute must authorise the deprivation. Compensation and public-purpose arguments depend on the statute and on 31A–31C where those savings apply.
